server.note: Commands ran under the IIS worker. The 2026 entry vector is unknown.

implants.note: Witchetty implants include the Avast wsc_proxy hijack and the McAfee mfeann.exe pair. The profile is a DLL-load hunt, not a hash match.

modules.note: Forty-one PowerShell modules under the existing webshell. The shared scaffold is script content, not a process name.

hunt.note: The modules searched for passwords, keys, and tokens and tested them against exchange APIs. A successful login was not observed.

exfil.note: Output left as DNS lookups to an oast.pro token. The collector was not visible, and Symantec did not see data theft.
